data.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Completes Taalas Acquisition - Simply Wall St News
data.summary: - Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) completed the acquisition of AI inference chip startup Taalas, adding specialized accelerator expertise to its portfolio. - Management plans to fold Taalas' inference technology into future Instinct data center GPU and accelerator roadmaps for AI workloads. - AMD expanded its quantum computing collaboration with PsiQuantum to pair AMD CPUs and GPUs with PsiQuantum's photonic quantum systems for scientific and AI applications. [...] 3 things going right for Advanced Micro Devices that this headline doesn't cover. How the Taalas deal and PsiQuantum pact stress test AMD’s “complete AI infrastructure” story The Advanced Micro Devices Narrative rests on the idea that the business can move from selling individual chips to supplying full AI infrastructure, from Instinct accelerators and EPYC server CPUs through to Helios rack-scale systems and ROCm software. This news goes straight at that claim. [...] “The main thing that has to go right is for AMD to convert its AI accelerator ramps, ROCm software progress and Helios rack commitments into sustainably higher data center margins…” See how the full story points towards a $647 fair value for Advanced Micro Devices.
